query: INSERT INTO social_media_streamer_settings (streamer_login, twitch_user_id, approval_mode, timezone, subtitles_enabled, updated_at, updated_by) SELECT twitch_login, twitch_user_id, $2, $3, $4, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, $5 FROM twitch_streamers WHERE twitch_user_id = $1 ON CONFLICT (twitch_user_id) WHERE twitch_user_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET streamer_login = EXCLUDED.streamer_login, approval_mode = EXCLUDED.approval_mode, timezone = EXCLUDED.timezone, subtitles_enabled = EXCLUDED.subtitles_enabled, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
